scope: Cloud CPU implementation and reporting validation; no live CARC allocation, GPU execution, neural training or FNO comparison
commands: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_work_precision_*.py tests/test_interaction_*.py tests/test_mechanism_carc.py tests/test_research_carc.py tests/test_research_neural_workflow.py tests/test_research_replication_carc.py tests/test_tower_*.py --basetemp .runtime/pytest-work-precision-release --junitxml .runtime/work-precision-release-tests.xml
optional_test_note: One optional jsonschema pytest test skipped in the project venv; both generated reports and output contract independently passed 34 schema checks with the existing development validator. All numerical execution used the project venv.

experiment.reference_scope: Same-grid coupled FP64 RK4 n/2n/4n; full last RMS difference and rounding allowance; sqrt(N)*RMS maximum estimate is not a certificate
experiment.timing_scope: Prepared full CPU rollouts: all-method warmup once, then five rotated/interleaved repeats; validation and stop checks timed; setup separately timed
experiment.setup_inclusive_scope: One separately timed preparation sample plus median warmed rollout; excludes cache-metadata reporting, reference, warmup, parity, cloning, endpoint errors, reports and post-hoc selection; not a physical cold-cache measurement
experiment.selection_scope: posthoc_declared_grid; reference-informed, not a deployable adaptive policy
experiment.work_scope: Per-rollout actual method counters, including attempted invalid work; failed-call partial counters may be incomplete; no reference or setup work hidden in rollout counts

references.interpretation: The predeclared reference budget was unchanged. One rejected reference leaves all 56 of its method/norm/tolerance frontiers inconclusive; its candidate and parity observations remain retained.

limitations: Same-grid reference estimates are not continuum or rigorous error certificates.
Prepared-time and setup-inclusive frontiers are post-hoc choices using references, not runtime adaptive controllers.
Five rollout timing repetitions and one preparation measurement are descriptive CPU observations, not independent problem samples.
The 24 conditions are a partial stress design; several factors are coupled.
One reference did not satisfy the frozen precision budget; completion is not universal scientific feasibility.
